title: 小女孩第一次去海邊
logline: 小女孩第一次去海邊，發現了許多新奇和歡樂。

characters.name: 莉莉
characters.appearance: young girl, curly brown hair, pink sun hat, blue swimsuit, yellow sandals

panels.scene: 莉莉帶著媽媽第一次來到海邊，驚奇地看著遼闊的海洋。
panels.image_prompt: lily standing on sandy beach, looking at wide sea, morning light, gentle waves

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 莉莉第一次看到這麼大的海洋。

panels.scene: 莉莉彎腰用手摸海水，感覺冰涼又不一樣。
panels.image_prompt: lily touching sea water with hands, curious expression, small waves touching feet

panels.scene: 莉莉與媽媽一起堆沙堡，開心地笑著。
panels.image_prompt: lily and her hands building sandcastle, happy smile, bright sunlight

dialogue.speaker: lily
dialogue.text: 媽媽，我們一起蓋城堡吧！

panels.scene: 莉莉看到一隻小蟹子，輕輕地用手指指著牠。
panels.image_prompt: lily pointing at a small crab on sand, surprised and excited face

panels.scene: 太陽漸漸西下，莉莉坐在沙灘上看著美麗的夕陽。
panels.image_prompt: lily sitting on sand, watching sunset, warm orange glow, peaceful mood

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 一天的海邊時光讓莉莉好滿足。

panels.scene: 莉莉和媽媽手牽手離開海邊，莉莉露出幸福微笑。
panels.image_prompt: lily holding mom's hand, walking away from beach, soft evening light, smiling face
